0.name: TEXT_FESNYR2022GUIDE_00699_TIGERSERVER_000_000
0.description: Good morrow to you, my <hex:02080FE905FF056C616479FF056C6F726403>. I am the tora doshin, a member of a Far Eastern delegation come to share our traditions of Heavensturn with the good people of Eorzea. If there is aught you would know of this year's celebration, you need only ask.

6.name: TEXT_FESNYR2022GUIDE_00699_TIGERSERVER_000_001
6.description: At the turning of the year, a small delegation of our people will journey to Eorzea to celebrate the coming of Heavensturn, and in so doing, strengthen the bonds of friendship between Eorzea and the Far East.

7.name: TEXT_FESNYR2022GUIDE_00699_TIGERSERVER_000_002
7.description: To mark the occasion, our leader, the tora bugyo, put forward a most interesting idea─distribute advent cakes to the people of Limsa Lominsa. Please do try some. They are quite delicious.

8.name: TEXT_FESNYR2022GUIDE_00699_TIGERSERVER_000_010
8.description: You were a great help with the Heavensturn ritual, my <hex:02080FE905FF056C616479FF056C6F726403>. Allow me to thank you once more on behalf of our delegation.

9.name: TEXT_FESNYR2022GUIDE_00699_TIGERSERVER_000_011
9.description: We plan to repeat the ritual a few more times during Heavensturn. Pray lend us your aid again if and when you are able.

10.name: TEXT_FESNYR2022GUIDE_00699_TIGERSERVER_000_030
10.description: At the turning of the year, a small delegation of our people will journey to Eorzea to celebrate the coming of Heavensturn, and in so doing, strengthen the bonds of friendship between Eorzea and the Far East.

11.name: TEXT_FESNYR2022GUIDE_00699_TIGERSERVER_000_031
11.description: To mark the occasion, our leader, the tora bugyo, put forward a most interesting idea─distribute advent cakes to the people of Limsa Lominsa. Please do try some. They are quite delicious.

12.name: TEXT_FESNYR2022GUIDE_00699_TIGERSERVER_000_040
12.description: You are unfamiliar with this festival? The tradition has a rich history which dates back centuries, but I do not wish to bore you, so I shall try and keep my summation brief.

13.name: TEXT_FESNYR2022GUIDE_00699_TIGERSERVER_000_041
13.description: Heavensturn is a celebration that marks the start of a new year, though the way in which this day is observed differs from region to region. Here in Eorzea, it is said the Twelve select one among them to keep vigil over the realm until the next passing of the twelve moons. I believe this year it is Azeyma, the keeper of the sun and goddess of inquiry, who has been charged with this duty.

14.name: TEXT_FESNYR2022GUIDE_00699_TIGERSERVER_000_042
14.description: In the Far East, however, the changing of the year is heralded by one of twelve totem animals. As you have no doubt discerned from my helm, this year we pay homage to the fearsome tora.

15.name: TEXT_FESNYR2022GUIDE_00699_TIGERSERVER_000_043
15.description: I speak of the creature you would know better as a “tiger.”

16.name: TEXT_FESNYR2022GUIDE_00699_CUWSERVER_000_050
16.description: Advent cakes are a special kind of mochi, or rice cake, made specifically to celebrate Heavensturn. To be precise, they are made by pouring steaming bowls of rice into a mortar, near full to the brim, and then pounding the whole until it forms a thick white dough, which is then turned into advent cakes.

17.name: TEXT_FESNYR2022GUIDE_00699_CUWSERVER_000_051
17.description: No doubt you shall have the chance to see some with your own eyes soon enough. The mochi daikan has been toiling of late in order to prepare plenty for the festival, and I am sure he has some to spare for you.
